expectations.text: All three files exist: codemap.html, codemap.json, codemap.lock
codemap.json parses and has the six required top-level keys
Every node has id, path, role, entrypoints, tests, constraints, evidence
Every node path exists on disk in the repo
Every evidence symbol is literally findable in the file its path names
expectations.evidence: 15 unfindable e.g. ["cmd-auditkit->pkg-cli:'cli.NewSpinner(...)' in scanner/cmd/auditkit/main.go", "cmd-auditkit->pkg-tracker:'tracker.ControlResult (type use only; no function of pkg/tracker is called)' in scanner/cmd/auditkit/main.go", "cmd-provider-clis->pkg-core:'core.ScanResult in outputJSON signature' in scanner/cmd/auditkit-aws/main.go"]

expectations.text: Every entrypoint is a {path, symbol} pair so it can be machine-verified
Every edge type is within the allowed six-value enum
Every edge endpoint and flow step resolves to an existing node id
codemap.html carries the same nodes/edges/flows as codemap.json inline
expectations.evidence: inline blob carries 33 node ids, 39 edges, 4 flows; matches codemap.json

expectations.text: codemap.html has no external network references (fully self-contained)
codemap.html header shows repo name, generation time and source commit
codemap.lock records commit, dirty flag, scope, exclusions, algorithm, per-module fingerprints
codemap.lock commit matches the repo's actual HEAD
At least 3 flows, each with trigger, steps and outcome
Unknowns are marked in the evidence field (never as a type) and carry a note
